segments.title: 第191章 又挨揍了
segments.content:
Chapter 191: Got Beaten Up Again

After an energetic game of hide-and-seek, the group played for over an hour until they were finally too tired to continue.

At first, everyone was quite conventional, hiding under the table, under the coffee table, behind the curtains.

Later, after these spots were overused, Li Luo started to deliberately alter the terrain. He pushed the sofa to the desk, and the desk to the wall, completely sealing off the space under the desk so the seeker couldn't even get in.

Afterward, Li Luo even put a chair on the desk and stood on it in a golden-rooster-stands-on-one-leg pose, leaving Ying Chanxi to fumble for ages, completely unable to figure out what new thing was on the desk.

By a little after ten in the evening, everyone was getting a bit tired, and their stomachs were rumbling.

So, Li Luo dragged Zhao Rongjun into the kitchen and began teaching him how to make egg fried rice.

"So, what are you teaching me this for?" Zhao Rongjun was a bit bewildered and asked doubtfully.

"Don't you want to earn money?"

"With egg fried rice?"

"That's right." Li Luo nodded, taking out the extra rice he had purposely cooked in the evening. "The down jacket you want to buy isn't expensive. If you want to earn a few hundred kuai, you can probably save enough in one or two weeks if you're quick."

"But... where am I supposed to go to sell egg fried rice?" Zhao Rongjun looked speechless. "Besides, I don't have the time for that usually."

"That's where you're wrong." Li Luo wagged his finger. "We can sell it to our schoolmates."

"Huh?" Zhao Rongjun froze for a moment. "How would we do that?"

"It's simple." Li Luo took eggs out of the fridge, along with a few sausages and a carrot. "Have you ever been to our school's dormitory area?"

"Never."

Zhao Rongjun was a day student who usually went back to his grandpa's house after school, so he had indeed never been to the dorms.

Li Luo nodded in understanding and explained to him, "From our school's main gate, you walk across the street, and right there is the gate to the dormitory area."

"After you enter the gate, you'll pass by a small supermarket. When everyone goes back to their dorms at night, they can buy some snacks or instant noodles at the supermarket to fill their stomachs if they're hungry."

"And after the supermarket, there's still a short walk before you reach the first dorm building, which is the boys' dorm. Further back is the girls' dorm building."

Pausing here, Li Luo continued, "Between the boys' and girls' dorm buildings, near the eastern wall, there's an iron fire escape gate. It's usually closed, but the gaps are quite wide."

"Wide enough to pass a plastic lunch box through, no problem."

"What do you think?"

Zhao Rongjun's mouth hung open, momentarily at a loss for words.

He wanted to find an angle to argue against it, but he also felt like it might be doable.

"But... who would buy it?" Zhao Rongjun asked hesitantly. "When everyone gets back to their dorms, they've already bought things at the supermarket. They might not even notice any activity over by the fire escape gate, right?"

"We're not going to have to squat by the wall and hawk our wares, are we?"

"If the dorm matron finds out, will she call security to chase us away?"

"You don't have to worry too much about whether anyone will buy it," Li Luo said. "After all, the supermarket only sells snacks and instant noodles. There will always be classmates who get tired of those and want to eat a hot meal like fried rice at night."

"But what you said later, that's something we really need to be careful about. We should try our best not to be discovered by security."

"Besides, we're not planning to do this long-term. It's just to help you earn some money to buy down jackets for your grandparents."

"At most, we'll stop after half a month. Using the money you earned through your own hard work to buy clothes is a pretty meaningful thing."

Hearing Li Luo's analysis, Zhao Rongjun was already very tempted and nodded vigorously. "You have a point. I think we can give it a try. I'll learn from you first, then how do we arrange things?"

"Just tell your grandpa that the final exams are coming up, and you need to come to my place after school to continue studying together," Li Luo said. "Then, as soon as the second evening self-study session is over, we'll sprint back here immediately."

"Before the third evening self-study session ends, we'll make as many servings of fried rice as we can, then take them over to the fire escape gate to sell."

"For one serving of egg fried rice, if we control the cost, it'll be two or three kuai at most."

"We'll sell it for ten kuai a box, so the profit will be over seven kuai. Based on a profit of five hundred kuai, we'll only need to sell about 70 boxes to make it."

Of course, Li Luo didn't factor in things like labor costs, purely talking about the cost of the ingredients for the egg fried rice itself.

Since it was just for fun anyway, he couldn't be bothered to calculate it too carefully with Zhao Rongjun.

As for making money... if he wrote one more chapter now, he could probably make back that few hundred kuai.

He was only suggesting this to Zhao Rongjun out of consideration for his good friend.

After all, it was to buy clothes for his grandparents. Li Luo was more than willing to support such a filial gesture.

Thinking of this, Li Luo also added, "When you've saved enough money and are going to buy the down jackets, remember to let me know. I'll go with you."

"Huh?" Zhao Rongjun was stunned. "Why are you coming with me?"

"I'll buy some clothes for my family too," Li Luo said with a smile.

Reminded by Zhao Rongjun, Li Luo suddenly realized that after his rebirth, he had bought gifts for Ying Chanxi and the others but had never thought of buying anything for his parents.

Thinking about it, he really had lived for over thirty years for nothing. He wasn't even as thoughtful as Zhao Rongjun...

"Okay." Zhao Rongjun nodded happily. "Then we'll go buy them together!"

When it came to egg fried rice, if you said it was simple, it was indeed simple. Almost anyone could learn and make a decent version.

But if you said it was difficult, it could be considered quite difficult, because there were many tricks to making it delicious.

Especially since the methods for making egg fried rice differed by region and so did the flavors, all requiring slight adjustments.

Fortunately, Li Luo had run a roadside stall in his previous life, specializing in things like stir-fried rice noodles, fried rice, and stir-fried noodles, so he was an expert in this area.

Even though Zhao Rongjun was a novice, he was still able to pick things up quickly, just a little unpracticed.

Besides, Li Luo wasn't just going to let him do it all by himself. When the time came, the two of them would definitely work together to speed up the cooking process. Soon, under Li Luo's guidance, six servings of fried rice were fresh out of the wok.

The two of them carried the fried rice to the dining table and called for the girls, who were watching videos on the sofa, to come have a late-night snack.

Paired with the snacks they had bought from the supermarket in the afternoon, which included side dishes like braised chicken legs and duck legs, they ate them with the fried rice, and their stomachs were soon refilled.

"How are we arranging the sleeping tonight?" Li Luo asked the others, rubbing his belly. "Zhao Rongjun will sleep in the same room as me, and there's one guest room left."

"Xinyan will sleep with me," Ying Chanxi said. "Zhusheng can take the guest room. Didn't she already sleep there this morning?"

"Let's do that then." Li Luo nodded. "You guys remember to wash the dishes. So, are we done for today?"

"What do you mean, done?" Xu Youyu's eyes widened. She slapped the table and said, "It's only a little past eleven! How can you fall asleep at this hour? Let's keep the party going!"

Li Luo: "...What else do you want to do?"

Xu Youyu rolled her eyes. "How about we watch a movie?"

Does she want to watch a movie, or does she want to get under the covers again?

Li Luo was speechless. "The TV in the living room can't play specific movies. The six of us can't all squeeze in front of the computer to watch, can we?"

"How about we just forget it?" Ying Chanxi suggested softly. "It's getting late. After we shower, it'll probably be midnight. We should get to bed early."

Qiao Xinyan also nodded. After all, she hadn't stayed up late like the others yesterday, so she was already feeling a bit sleepy.

Seeing this, Xu Youyu couldn't insist any longer and could only nod in agreement. "Alright then, I'll go wash the dishes first."

After the night's entertainment ended, Ying Chanxi took Qiao Xinyan back to the bedroom to get ready to wash up.

Li Luo also took Zhao Rongjun back to the master bedroom, let him shower first, while he himself sat at the computer desk and wrote for a while as Zhao Rongjun was in the shower.

After Zhao Rongjun finished showering and went to bed, Li Luo also took a quick rinse, changed into his pajamas, and walked out of the bedroom to the living room, planning to have a glass of water before sleeping.

But then he saw Yan Zhusheng sitting on the sofa watching TV.

"You're not asleep yet?" Li Luo poured a glass of water and asked while drinking.

"Senior Sister is taking a shower," Yan Zhusheng said. "She asked me to shower with her, but I said no, so I'm waiting here."

"Why not shower together?" Li Luo asked curiously. "Xixi has showered with her before."

"Mmm..." Yan Zhusheng looked down at herself, then shook her head. "I just don't want to."

"Alright then, I'm heading back to my room to sleep."

"Wait." Yan Zhusheng, sitting on the sofa, turned to look at him. "Do you want to practice the guitar for a bit? We didn't get to practice for long this evening."

Hearing her question, Li Luo couldn't help but ask, "How long has Senior Sister been in there?"

"Just a few minutes."

"Oh, then I'll keep you company for a while." Li Luo nodded and walked into the piano room with Yan Zhusheng.

After all, in his impression, Xu Youyu always took a long time to shower, at least half an hour.

It wasn't right to keep Yan Zhusheng, a guest, waiting in the living room.

So the two of them went to the piano room together and started the guitar lesson once more.

On the other side, after showering with Qiao Xinyan, Ying Chanxi took her best friend to bed.

The two lay in bed, ready for some bedtime talk.

"Xixi, you really like stuffed animals." Qiao Xinyan looked at the giant panda plushie on the bed, as well as the Pikachu and Doraemon on the nightstand, and exclaimed in amazement. "Some of the boys in our class said you liked these things, and I didn't quite believe it."

Although Qiao Xinyan had been here as a guest before, she had never been inside Ying Chanxi's bedroom. This was her first time seeing these plushies, and she found it quite novel.

"It's not that I like them that much," Ying Chanxi said softly, but she still hugged the panda plushie beside her a little tighter.

"Can I hug it?" Qiao Xinyan, seeing the panda's fluffy appearance, was also tempted and couldn't help but ask.

But to her surprise, Ying Chanxi immediately pulled the panda plushie a little further away from her and said softly, "N-not this one. You can hug the two on the nightstand."

"Oh, I see." Qiao Xinyan was slightly surprised, but seeing how much she treasured it, she felt too embarrassed to ask again.

So she reached out, took the Pikachu and Doraemon from the nightstand, placed them on the bed, and patted their heads. Then she asked with some confusion, "Xixi, why do I feel like these two are a bit old? They look like you've had them for a long time."

"Uh... umm... y-yes, they are."

Ying Chanxi gave an awkward smile, not knowing how to respond.

After all, with the domestic abuse they suffered from time to time, it would be strange if they didn't get old.

And when she thought about this evening, how she saw Yan Zhusheng practically hugging Li Luo while teaching him guitar in the piano room.

Then she thought about later during the game, when Yan Zhusheng pinched Li Luo's cheeks to put lipstick on him.

And then during hide-and-seek, how Yan Zhusheng squeezed into Li Luo's arms and fell on top of him, Ying Chanxi immediately pursed her lips.

So, under Qiao Xinyan's gaze, Ying Chanxi subconsciously raised her little fist and gave Pikachu's head four punches.

Then, on second thought, she gave Doraemon a punch too.

"Xixi... why are you hitting them?"

"They're soft, and it feels nice. Xinyan, you can try it too," Ying Chanxi fibbed with a straight face.

(End of this chapter)
